faq.question: Q1. What is MRPL Fire Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited for engaging 5 Fire Officer personnel on Fixed Term Employment (PFTE).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for MRPL Fire Officer?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for the Fire Officer post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MRPL Fire Officer?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting online applications is 07-11-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for MRPL Fire Officer?
faq.answer: The educational qualification is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MRPL Fire Officer?
faq.answer: The age limit is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for MRPL Fire Officer?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for MRPL Fire Officer?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online by visiting the official website at https://www.mrpl.co.in/careers.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MRPL Fire Officer?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be called for Personal Interview (PI) after screening of the applications.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for MRPL Fire Officer?
faq.answer: The post is placed at Executive Level L1.

faq.question: Q10. When will the MRPL Fire Officer exam be held?
faq.answer: There is no written examination; eligible candidates will be called for Personal Interview (PI) after screening of the applications.
